title: Choose fcullmann.com's visual world
question: This is a completely fresh hand. Choose a direction, steer the next re-roll, or take the quiet category-standard exit.

options.label: Request Waterfall
options.lineage: browser network inspectors, request waterfalls, and performance traces
options.thesis: The homepage behaves like a live request trace: Florian's work enters, resolves, and becomes useful output along one precise timeline.
options.viewport: A slim navigation and bold introduction occupy the left timing rail while a live formatter resolves across the main timeline; popular tools continue below as ranked, inspectable traces.
options.risk: The native developer reference is immediately credible, but it must avoid looking like a DevTools skin pasted over a portfolio.

raised.raise: Earlier work remains visible as useful history instead of disappearing behind the newest item.
Changing tool state receives one physically legible transition rather than generic loading chrome.
The active task stays sharp while supporting biography and writing recede without vanishing.

options.label: API Atlas
options.lineage: technical atlases, RFC diagrams, and field navigation charts
options.thesis: A navigable atlas maps Florian's tools, projects, and writing as destinations in one practical software territory.
options.viewport: A clear professional statement anchors the map legend; one route opens into a live JSON tool while featured destinations and recent field notes remain visible around it.
options.risk: Maps are a familiar information metaphor, so the live tool and route logic must carry more weight than decorative cartography.

options.label: Measured Output
options.lineage: nixie-tube laboratory counters and precision instrument panels
options.thesis: Every tool is judged by visible output: characters formatted, bytes converted, and tasks completed become the interface's measured pulse.
options.viewport: Florian's concise introduction shares a dark instrument panel with a bright working formatter; popular tools read as calm output banks rather than marketing cards.
options.case: It communicates precision and feedback strongly, but product breadth survives only if glowing counters stay secondary to readable tools and articles.
options.risk: Too much warm glow would turn a professional site into retro-futurist theater.

options.label: Live Source
options.lineage: algorave source projections and live-coded visual systems
options.thesis: The source is the stage: visitors edit a real value immediately and watch the site explain Florian's practice through the result.
options.viewport: An oversized live code buffer carries the first interaction while Florian's identity, featured tools, and writing lock to its execution rhythm.
options.case: The live mechanism earns developer attention and makes utility undeniable; broader visitors need a disciplined reading layer outside the source stage.
options.risk: Without editorial restraint it can resemble the terminal aesthetic the category already overuses.

options.label: Working Layers
options.thesis: New tools layer over an honest archive of shipped work, with older releases always recoverable beneath.
options.viewport: The newest tool occupies a crisp top sheet while visitors peel back releases, projects, and articles underneath.
options.case: The chronological layering is strong, but torn-paper interaction conflicts with the calm reliability expected of everyday utilities.
options.kept: The archive must remain tangible when new work ships.
options.risk: Visual noise and distressed material would overwhelm scanning.

options.label: Tool Cast
options.thesis: Each tool has a distinct personality and live popularity rank inside a growing roster.
options.viewport: A friendly ranked roster follows Florian's introduction, with every tool carrying a concise character-like profile.
options.case: Ranking maps cleanly to usage, but mascots weaken senior professional positioning and create a costly illustration dependency.
options.kept: A large catalogue needs distinct, memorable identities without losing consistency.
options.risk: It would feel playful where the brief calls for composed technical authority.

options.label: Layered Depth
options.lineage: multiplane cel animation and rack-focus cinematography
options.thesis: Biography, tools, and writing occupy separate planes that come into focus as visitors move through the site.
options.viewport: The interface travels through layered professional work, bringing one working tool into sharp focus against quieter context.
options.case: The focus model is useful, but painted scenery has little authentic connection to software utilities and raises performance cost.
options.kept: Attention should shift deliberately between the active task and contextual content.
options.risk: Cinematic atmosphere would make the tool collection feel indirect.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A polished developer portfolio with a conventional hero, tool cards, article list, and restrained blue accents.
canonCard.viewport: A centered navigation sits above a two-column introduction, followed by a uniform row of featured tools.
canonCard.risk: Immediately legible, but intentionally close to the Bootstrap-like pattern the brief asks to move beyond.
